questions.statement: A Venturi mask can deliver a controlled oxygen concentration.
questions.rationale: A Venturi mask is used to control inspired oxygen concentration.

questions.statement: A nonrebreather mask has a reservoir bag for high-concentration oxygen delivery.
questions.rationale: The reservoir bag supports high-concentration oxygen delivery.

questions.statement: Restraints should be the first response when a confused patient pulls at a line.
questions.rationale: Appropriate less-restrictive alternatives should be considered before restraints.

questions.statement: A near miss is intercepted before it reaches the patient.
questions.rationale: A near miss is an event or error caught before reaching the patient.

questions.statement: Facing a patient and speaking clearly can help communication with hearing impairment.
questions.rationale: Facing the patient can support speechreading and communication.

questions.statement: A patient's self-report is an important part of pain assessment.
questions.rationale: Patient self-report is a key component of pain assessment.

questions.statement: Family members should routinely press the patient's PCA button while the patient sleeps.
questions.rationale: Patient-controlled analgesia is intended to be controlled by the patient.

questions.statement: Guided imagery may supplement prescribed pain management.
questions.rationale: Guided imagery is a complementary comfort technique.
